guidelines.document_title: APA Research Standards & NICE CG113 Evidence Synthesis
guidelines.section_title: Acute Cognitive Stress & State Arousal Rapid Intervention Protocols
guidelines.chunk_content: For participants exhibiting acute cognitive workload or task-induced arousal: recommend sensory grounding (5-4-3-2-1 technique), structured cognitive pacing via 25-minute Pomodoro intervals, and diaphragmatic breathing to support parasympathetic recovery. If symptoms persist beyond transient task-related strain, suggest consulting a qualified healthcare professional.

guidelines.document_title: American Psychological Association (APA) Mind-Body Health Framework
guidelines.chunk_content: Baseline resting physiological state confirmed: participant displays synchronized posterior alpha rhythm and nominal beta power. Advise continued preventive wellness practices including consistent nocturnal circadian patterns, periodic cognitive decompression breaks, hydration, and structured study intervals.

guidelines.document_title: Association for Applied Psychophysiology and Biofeedback (AAPB) Guidelines
guidelines.chunk_content: In the presence of elevated frontal beta synchronization and decreased alpha dominance, slow-paced resonant frequency breathing at 0.1 Hz (~6 breaths/min) stimulates baroreceptor reflexes, supports vagal tone recovery, and restores prefrontal attentional capacity within 3 to 5 minutes.
